_comment: Curated DEMO catalog of sustainable alternative products used as the retrieval corpus. Scores are EcoFinance editorial estimates (0-100), not certifications. This is demo data to make semantic retrieval real, not a production dataset.

products.name: Allbirds Wool Runners
products.description: Sustainable running shoes made from merino wool and eucalyptus fiber with sugarcane soles; carbon-neutral certified, machine washable, low-emission materials.

products.name: Veja Campo Sneakers
products.description: Chrome-free leather sneakers made with wild rubber from the Amazon and organic cotton; transparent supply chain and fair-trade sourcing.

products.name: Thousand Fell Recycled Court Sneaker
products.description: Closed-loop recyclable sneakers made from recycled bottles and bio-leather; free take-back recycling program keeps shoes out of landfill.

products.name: Patagonia Organic Cotton Hoody
products.description: Fair Trade Certified sewing, 100% organic cotton hoodie from a brand known for environmental activism, repair programs, and recycled materials.

products.name: Tentree Classic Hoodie
products.description: Hoodie made from organic cotton and recycled polyester; B Corp that plants ten trees for every item purchased.

products.name: Kuyichi Organic Hoodie
products.description: GOTS-certified organic cotton apparel from a pioneer fair-fashion brand focused on circular production and living wages.

products.name: Farmers Market Seasonal Produce Box
products.description: Seasonal, locally grown organic produce with minimal packaging and near-zero transport emissions; supports local regenerative farms.

products.name: Imperfect Foods Grocery Box
products.description: Surplus and 'ugly' produce delivery that reduces food waste and packaging compared to conventional grocery retail.

products.name: Equal Exchange Organic Whole Bean Coffee
products.description: Fair-trade, organic, shade-grown coffee from small farmer cooperatives; compostable packaging and long-term direct trade relationships.

products.name: Local Coffee Shop Brew with Reusable Cup Discount
products.description: Locally roasted, ethically sourced coffee at an independent cafe; many offer discounts for reusable cups and compost their grounds.

products.name: Clipper Organic Loose Leaf Tea
products.description: Fairtrade and organic loose leaf tea with plastic-free packaging from a certified B Corp.

products.name: Monthly Public Transit Pass
products.description: Low-carbon commuting via bus or rail; dramatically lower emissions per mile than rideshare or single-occupancy cars.

products.name: City Bike Share Membership
products.description: Zero-emission urban transport; e-bike and classic bike share memberships cover short trips that would otherwise be rideshare rides.

products.name: EV Carpool Ride Credit
products.description: Shared electric-vehicle rides that split emissions across passengers; lower-impact alternative to solo rideshare trips.

products.name: Plant-Based Meal Kit (Two Servings)
products.description: 100% plant-based meal kit; lower carbon and water footprint than restaurant beef meals and fast food.

products.name: Local Salad Bar Grain Bowl
products.description: Plant-forward fast casual meal from a local restaurant using seasonal ingredients and compostable packaging.

products.name: Who Gives A Crap Recycled Toilet Paper
products.description: 100% recycled bath tissue, plastic-free packaging, and 50% of profits donated to sanitation projects.

products.name: Blueland Cleaning Tablet Refill Kit
products.description: Refillable cleaning products that eliminate single-use plastic bottles; Cradle-to-Cradle certified tablets.

products.name: thredUP Pre-Loved Wool Sweater
products.description: Certified secondhand clothing; extends garment life and avoids the full footprint of new apparel production.

products.name: Insulated Reusable Water Bottle
products.description: Climate-certified B Corp stainless steel bottle that replaces single-use plastic water bottles.

products.name: Renewable Energy Utility Plan
products.description: Electricity plan backed by wind and solar renewable energy certificates; lower-carbon home energy alternative.

products.name: Library E-Book and Audiobook Membership
products.description: Free digital borrowing that avoids the manufacturing and shipping footprint of new books and media.

products.name: Repair Cafe Fix-It Session
products.description: Volunteer-run repair sessions that extend the life of electronics, clothing, and furniture instead of replacing them.
